title: New York Life, Accident, and Health Insurance Agent/Broker

exam.experimentalItemsNote: PSI states 5 to 10 unscored experimental items may be added in addition to the scored items; this simulator uses only the 150 scored items.

prelicensing.note: 40-hour approved combined Life/A&H prelicensing course is required (or a qualifying exemption). Study time in this app is independent study and is NOT approved prelicensing credit; only a DFS-approved provider issues a School Certificate.

source.note: PSI NY Insurance Candidate Information Bulletin, 'Updated 4/28/2023'. Bulletin IDs 7208 and 7228 served byte-identical PDFs on 2026-11-19 (sha256 2cf26319...df4df); no newer NY edition was found.
source.hierarchyNote: Hierarchy reconstructed from PDF indentation (x-offsets). A few items whose indentation in the PDF was ambiguous were normalized (PPO/POS/EPO, indemnity plan features and catastrophic under Medical Plans > Types of plans; LTC benefit periods/amounts/ADLs and plan-type items under LTC > Benefits; FMLA and nondiscrimination rules under Group > Regulation). Every token of the official outline text is preserved.
